description: This file defines a Java interface 'ServiceAvailabilityCheckable' that specifies methods for checking and waiting for service availability.

classes.name: ServiceAvailabilityCheckable
classes.description: A Java interface for services that support checking their availability and waiting for them to become available.

methods.name: isServiceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the service is currently available and returns a boolean result.

methods.name: waitForServiceToBeAvailable
methods.description: Blocks until the service becomes available or the timeout occurs, returning a boolean indicating the result.
